newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues, distillates stocks up.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues, distillates stocks up.

text.p: Singapore weekly residues stocks rose by 1.38 million barrels, to 11.302 million barrels for the week ending May 14, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) statistics showed on Thursday.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 166,000 barrels to 8.964 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillates stocks were also up by 75,000 barrels to 7.632 million barrels.
Light distillate comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
